answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 28608 Country: India Title: Respected pious scholar, Bleaching:cream is applied on face and hairs of the face turns white.Is bleaching allowed in islam?I will be highly obliged to you if any advice. Question: Assalaamu Alaikum wa Rahmatullaahi wa Barakatuhu! Respected pious scholar, Bleaching:cream is applied on face and hairs of the face turns white.Is bleaching allowed in islam?I will be highly obliged to you if any advice. JAZAKALLAH KHARIAN! Answer ID: 28608 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 99/81/L=1432) The women are allowed to apply bleach on face in order to remove hair growing on the face. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
